title: Question 0.4: Dataset Object Creation
instruction: This code creates a Dataset object by reading data from a file. The Dataset will contain all the data from the CSV file.
reveal: This code reads a CSV file and creates a `Dataset<Row>` object called `data`. The `.read()` method starts the reading process, `.option("header", "true")` tells Spark that the first row contains column names, `.schema(schema)` specifies the structure of the data, and `.csv(CSV_FILE)` reads from the CSV file. The result is a Dataset object that contains all the data from the file, organized in rows and columns.
